id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. D1-EST-001. Never reused after retirement.

cou.description: Which context(s) of use this item supports. Scores must be reported per COU.

verification.description: deterministic = exact/tolerance/unit tests/artefact diff; drives whether misclassification correction applies.

difficulty.description: consolidation = a competent statistician answers without reference; practitioner = requires domain experience; expert = requires specialist subdomain knowledge or careful reasoning.

family_id.description: Set only if the item shares a stem with others. Items sharing a family_id are NOT independent; family_id is the bootstrap resampling unit.

template_id.description: Which of the >=3 paraphrase templates this text instantiates.

provenance.description: Public source of the data. MUST NOT be proprietary or patient-level sponsor data.

answer_key.description: Present for deterministic items authored inline. Production items use answer_key_ref instead - see A.5 of the Claude Code addendum: inline keys in a shared item file are a review convenience only, never the scored layout.

value.description: null is the documented placeholder for T3_code/T7_agentic items awaiting key generation by execution (CLAUDE.md rule 2) - never hand-typed.

derivation.description: How the key was computed. Required: a key without a derivation is unauditable.

missing_information.description: For T6: the specific items a correct response must identify as missing.

answer_key_ref.description: Path to the item's key file under _keys/, e.g. _keys/D2-GSD-012.yaml. Production layout: the harness loads answer_key content from here instead of inline. Mutually exclusive with a populated answer_key on the same item.

rubric.description: Present for judge-graded items. Each criterion independently checkable.

kind.description: alternative = one of an enumerated set of defensible positions; credit if any one is taken AND justified.

provenance.description: Guidance section, publication, or SOP establishing this criterion.

reference_response.description: Human-authored. Model-generated references import the judge's blind spots and are not permitted for scored items.

answer_key_delta.description: How the key changes under this perturbation.

author_disagreement.description: Proportion of criteria on which independent authors initially disagreed. High values flag a poorly specified item, not a hard one.

source_date.description: Date of the newest source relied on. Used for temporal contamination partitioning.
